lines.text: Sending a file shouldn't need an account, an app, or a cable.
Meet Orbi Transfer. Open it in any browser, and you're ready.
Pick your files, give them a name, and hit send.
They float into orbit, and show up on every nearby screen. Instantly.
On your phone, just tap, and it's yours. No password, unless you want one.
Sending a whole batch? It lands as one tidy container, with a single download all.
Working with a team? Open a private space. Only the people in your office see what you share.
Close your laptop. Your file stays safe in the cloud, end-to-end encrypted, until its timer runs out.
Free. No login. Up to five gigabytes, on any device.
Orbi Transfer. Send it into orbit.
